# dynarmic-rs
Rust bindings for dynarmic, an ARM dynamic recompiler. 

[![Crates.io Version](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/dynarmic.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/dynarmic)
[![CI](https://github.com/exverge-0/dynarmic-rs/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/exverge-0/dynarmic-rs/actions/)

## Examples
You can find some minimal examples in [tests/](https://github.com/exverge-0/dynarmic-rs/tree/master/tests/) on the GitHub page.
